text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. aircraft carrier to pull out of the Gulf by next week unless deemed necessary, Washington says.
- Commerce and Industry Ministry to set up a commercial information centre in a free-trade zone due to open later this year.
- An eight million dinar real estate deal concluded.
- Kuwait is in "jeopardy" -- were opposition veteran MP Ahmad al-Khatib's final words to parliament. Khatib is not seeking re-election in the October 7 polls.
- Gulf Cooperation Council states agree to strengthen commercial ties with South American grouping.
- Foreign commercial attaches visit Kuwait Stock Exchange.
- Kuwait has failed to restructure the military five years after the 1991 Gulf War, Parliament Speaker Ahmad al-Saadoun said in an election rally.
